votes.motion: Approve work session minutes from May 9, 2023; June 1, 2023 and June 6, 2023 and formal minutes from April 18, 2023 and June 13, 2023
votes.description: The Council approved multiple prior meeting minutes, including three work session minutes and two formal meeting minutes from spring 2023.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer Item B-1 to a future Consent Agenda for action
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on the Salt Lake City Police Department's grant application to the State of Utah Internet Crimes Against Children Task Force and referred it to a future consent agenda for action.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 46 of 2023, to amend various sections of Title 21A of the Salt Lake City Code pertaining to the sight distance triangle
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance amending zoning regulations for the sight distance triangle to include intersections with alleys and streets/sidewalks and to apply standards to buildings and all other structures, improving visual clearance at intersections.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 23 of 2023, adopting the Capital Improvement Program project-specific allocations for Fiscal Year 2024 as shown in Exhibit A Funding Log
votes.description: The Council adopted a resolution approving project-specific funding allocations for the FY2024 Capital Improvement Program, which covers construction, purchase, or renovation of City-owned physical structures.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 47 of 2023, approving a $100,000 loan for Leavity, LLC at 47 South Orange Street, B#1, from the Economic Development Loan Fund (EDLF)
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance approving a $100,000 loan to Leavity, LLC, a wholesale sourdough bread bakery, from the Economic Development Loan Fund to assist in job creation and retention.

The Council approved the consent agenda, which included setting public hearing dates for a budget amendment and fee schedule amendment, and approving the appointment of Elizabeth Hanna to the Police Civilian Review Board.
